description: Angular component for a device profile dialog in the Thingsboard UI, handling creation and editing of device profiles.

classes.name: DeviceProfileDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for device profile dialog, managing form state, save, and cancel actions.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets the form as dirty if adding a new device profile after view initialization.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state, considering custom submission state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the device profile, then closes the dialog with the saved profile.
